title: Zhitai Operations Metrics Report
description: Machine-readable contract for Zhitai operational KPIs, lineage, periodic platform snapshots, OFAT experiment cards, and 7/14/30-day reviews.

contractVersion.description: Legacy renderer compatibility alias of schemaVersion.

synthetic.description: Legacy renderer compatibility flag; it MUST agree with dataMode.

generatedAt.description: Legacy renderer timestamp. The current deterministic report builder sets it equal to asOf.

kpis.description: Canonical, formula-bearing KPI structure. The legacy metrics projection is separately retained for the existing renderer.

funnels.description: Canonical four-grain funnel structure. The legacy feedbackFunnel projection is separately retained for the existing renderer.

reviews.description: Canonical D7/D14/D30 review frames. The legacy reviewFramework projection is separately retained for the existing renderer.

metrics.description: Renderer-compatible KPI projection retained by contract 1.0.0. Runtime validation MUST cross-check its values and states against the normalized kpis structure.

feedbackFunnel.description: Renderer-compatible funnel projection retained by contract 1.0.0. Runtime validation MUST cross-check its stage and outcome counts against normalized funnels.

reviewFramework.description: Renderer-compatible review projection retained by contract 1.0.0. Runtime validation MUST cross-check due dates, cutoffs, statuses, and horizons against normalized reviews.

reportPeriodProjection.description: Legacy period projection accepted at adapter boundaries only. Canonical reports use reportPeriod with startAt/endAt/cohortAnchor.

distinctResolvedAssets.description: Auxiliary distinct material count resolved by intake attempts. It never replaces collection_volume's intake-attempt grain.

reportLineageProjection.description: Legacy compact lineage projection for adapter validation only. Canonical report roots use lineage; cross-record material ownership is enforced at runtime.

reportExperimentCard.description: Legacy OFAT card shape accepted by adapters only. Canonical report roots use experimentCard; exact one-factor change and locked conditions are enforced at runtime.

legacyMetricProjectionValue.description: Compatibility-only value emitted by the pre-canonical operations prototype. Adapters normalize units and expand coverage before populating kpis.

reportProvenanceProjection.description: Legacy compact provenance projection for adapter validation only. Canonical report roots use provenanceSource.
